name: fossil-wasm-parity
description: SC#1 manual cross-engine parity gate (ADR-0014): re-run the corpus SQL on DuckDB-WASM 1.33.x and diff the native_baseline.json digests.
comment: SC#1 targets DuckDB-WASM 1.33.x. The 1.33.x line is currently published only as the npm `latest` dev pre-release (1.33.1-devN.0); the last fully-stable tag is 1.32.0. We pin the npm `latest` (a 1.33.x build) for the manual parity gate; bump to a 1.33.x final when one ships. The native side is duckdb 1.10502 — the asymmetry is intentional, and this harness is what would catch a native/WASM divergence.
